paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Amite Vengtu Ding In Pathian In Ezekiel Asep / (Eze 3.16-21)

paite: "Mihing tapa, na nam tate kiang ah thu gen inla, akiang uah, gam tung a namsau ka hon tutleh gam mite'n alak ua pat mi khat atelkhiak ua, galvilmi dia akoih uleh,
ama'n gam tung a namsau hong tung amuhleh pengkul amut ding a, mipite akigalgingsak ding hi.
Huchi in pengkul ging za a poisaloumi kuapeuh, namsau hong tung in manloh tamahleh, asisan moh amah mah in apo ding ahi.
Pengkul ging azak a apoisak louh ziak in asisan moh akipuak mai ding ahi; ana poisakleh bel ahinna ahumbit ding ahi.

Himahleh galvilmi in namsau hong tung amuh a, apengkul amut louh a, mipite akigalgin louh ua, namsau ahong tun a, alak ua mi kuahiam in amanlohleh athulimlouhna in amangthang ding a, galvilmi khut ah asisan phu ka ngiat ding," chi in.
Huchibang in nang, mihing tapa, Israel inkote a dia galvilmi dia ka hon bawl na hi; huaiziak in ka kam a thupawt ngaikhia inla, ka kiang a kipan kigalginna ding thu akiang uah hilh in.
Migilou kiang ah, "Aw migilou, si mahmah ding na hi," ka chih a, migilou a-omdan paisan ding a na hilh keileh migilou agitlouhna ah asi ding a, asisan phu bel nang a kipan ka la ding.
Himahleh migilou a-omdan paisan ding a na hilh a, a-omdan apaisan kei laileh, agitlouhna ah asi ding a, nang bel na hinna na humbit ding hi.

Huan mihing tapa, nang Israel inkote kiang ah thu gen inla, hichibang in na chi ua, "Ka tatleknate uh leh ka khelhnate un ahon delhkhum a, huaiziak in ka thanggawp uh ahi, bangchi in ka hing nilouh thei ding ua?" na chi uhi.
heading: Mimal Mohpuakna

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei kei a, migilou in a-omdan apaisan a ahin ka kipah lam ahi zaw. Na omdan hoih lou ua kipan kik un, kik un, Aw Israel inkote, bangziak a si ding na hi ua? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in gen in.

"Nang, mihing tapa, na nam tate kiang ah gen inla, midiktat diktanna in atatlekna ni in amah ahumbit kei ding a, migilou gitlouhna in leng athulimlouhna alehngatsan ni in apuksak kei ding a, midiktat lah akhelhna ni in adiktatna in ahing thei tuan sam kei ding.
Midiktat kiang ah, na hing ngeingei ding, chih ka gen in, adiktatna muang a thil ahihkhelhleh athil dik hih khat leng theihgige ahi kei ding; athilhihkhelhsa ah asi zaw ding.
Huan migilou kiang ah, 'Na si ngeingei ding,' ka chih nawn leuleu in, agitlouhnate alehngatsan a asiang leh adik ana hih a,
migilou in mi koih khamnate pekik a, athilgukte apiak nawn a, hinna dante azuih a, thulimlouhna bangmah ahihkeileh ahing ngeingei ding a, asi kei ding hi.
Khelhna ana hihsa bangmah theihgige ahita kei ding a, asiang leh adik ana hihta a, ahing ngeingei ding hi.
"Himahleh na nam tate'n, 'TOUPA thilhihdan akikim kei,' achih un amau hihdan adiktat kei zaw hi.
Midiktat in adiktatna alehngatsan a, thil gilou ana hihleh huaiziak in asi mai ding.
Huan migilou in agitlouhna alehngatsan a, asiang leh adik ahihleh huaiziak in ahing ding.
Himahleh, 'TOUPA hihdan akikim kei,' na chi ua, aw Israel inkote michih noumau hihdan bang in vai ka hon hawmsak ding hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, i saltan akum sawm-le-nihna, akha sawmna, huai kha ani nga ni in Jerusalem a kipan taikhia mi khat ka kiang ah ahong pai a, "Khopi zoh ahita," ahong chi hi.
heading: Jerusalem Pukna Thuthang

paite: Huai mi taikhia ahong tun ma nitaklam in TOUPA'N ka tung ah akhut anga a; zinglam a ka kiang a hong pai in ka kam ahon kasak a, huchi in ka kam ka ka a, pau thei lou in ka om nawnta kei hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Mipite Khelhnate

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel gam a mun segawpsa nung a omte'n, 'Abraham khat ahi a, gam aluah a; eite bel tampi i hi ua, gam gouluah ding a piak hita ve hang,' chi in agen uhi.
Huaiziak in akiang uah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Sa sisan na ne ua, na milimte uh lam ah na mitte uh na lengtousak ua; sisan na suah ua, noute'n gam na tang ding uh maw?
Na namsau uh na muang ua; thilkihhuai na hih ua; michih in invengpa zi na hihbuah ua; noute'n gam na tang ding uh maw?'

Hichibang a akiang ua na gen ding ahi, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Kei ka hin bang in, mun segawpsa nung a omte namsau in apuk ngeingei ding ua, gamlak a omte sahang kiang ah nek khit dia pe ding ka hi; kulh kip leh khuk a omte hipi in asi ding uh.
Gam leng ka hihsia in, mulkimhuaitak in ka bawl ding a; athilhihtheihna, akisaktheihpih abeita ding; Israel tangte asegawp ding a, kuamah avialvak nawnta kei ding uh.
Thilkihhuai ahih ziak ua gam ka hihgawp a, mulkimhuaitak a ka bawl hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.' ”
Huan nang, mihing tapa, baang bul ah kongpite ah na nam tate'n ahon ngen susup ding ua, michih in a-unaute kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua, TOUPA kiang a kipan thupawt i ngaikhe ding uh, akichi ding uh.
heading: Zawlnei Thugen Gahte

paite: Huchi in ahonhon in na kiang ah ahong pai ding ua, ka mite bang mai in na ma ah ahong tu ding ua, na thu ahong ngaikhe ding ua, himahleh azui tuan kei ding uh; akam un itna thupitak ahihlang ding ua, alungtang un bel punna lam azuan ding.
Ngai in, nang bel amau a ding in itna la, kilawmtak a sak leh tum bang na hi ding; na thute angaikhia ua, himahleh azui tuan kei ding uh.
Hiai ahong tun hun chiang in ngai in, ahong tung lellel ahi, alak uah zawlnei a-om chih athei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
